text: Learning a new skill can be an exciting journey. First, you need patience because progress takes time. It is important to practice regularly, even just a little every day. There are many resources you can use, such as online videos, books, or apps. To stay motivated, track your progress. For example, you can write down what you learn each week. Seeing small improvements will encourage you to keep going. Remember, everyone makes mistakes at the beginning. The key is to stay positive and not give up. With practice and patience, you will improve step by step.
